artifact_observations.reasoning: The iridescence on the pearls appears slightly smeared or painterly rather than having sharp optical reflections typical of real nacre. Some highlights look soft and diffuse.
The small green flower/leaf details attached to the pearls lack clear structural definition. They appear to melt into the pearl surface or the chain without a clear mounting point or stem structure.
The pink background has a uniform, slightly noisy texture that lacks realistic fabric weave detail, appearing more like a generated noise pattern than a macro photo of cloth.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry and rule out misclassification as generic ornaments or other accessories.
To verify that the chain links are properly interlocked and not fused, and that pearls are distinct objects rather than melting into the chain.
To assess the realism of the metallic reflections and pearl iridescence, checking for AI-specific smoothing or texture inconsistencies.
To ensure the overlapping loops of the necklace cast correct shadows and maintain proper depth ordering on the flat surface.

focus_areas: Connectivity of chain links (fusion vs interlocking)
Realism of pearl iridescence and specular highlights
Structural integrity of small floral attachments
Shadow consistency between overlapping necklace segments
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'green floral' elements. In AI images, small intricate details like tiny flowers often melt into adjacent surfaces. Verify if they have independent geometry or if they are just texture blobs. Also, check if the chain links maintain consistent thickness and topology throughout the visible length.
